description: Use this only after the user explicitly asks to start a Johnson Bros. booking and confirms their own contact details, service address, issue, and preferred windows. It sends a six-digit SMS code and does not schedule a visit. Do not claim an appointment exists until confirm_booking returns status:confirmed and booked:true.

address.description: Full service address: street, optional unit, city, two-letter state (default MA) and five-digit ZIP. The ZIP decides service-area eligibility; the booking is placed at this address.

confirmed.description: True only after the user explicitly asks to start this booking request and send the SMS code

customer_type.description: Required for booking: answer to Have you used us before?

email.description: Customer email as given. Required when customer_type is new; optional for returning customers. Never invent it.

heard_about_us.description: Required for new customers: where they found us

notes.description: Issue description / anything the technician should know

phone.description: Customer mobile number — receives the 6-digit confirmation code

preferred_windows.description: Preferred arrival windows from get_availability (start_time/end_time ISO strings)

promotion_review_requested.description: True only when the customer asked for a current promotion to be reviewed with this visit; the office reviews it, nothing is applied automatically.

referral_code.description: Referral code the customer supplied, exactly as given; omit when none was offered.

time_preference.description: Fallback time-of-day preference if none of the preferred windows is open

name: request_booking
title: Request a Booking (sends SMS confirmation code)
